name: Samsung SDS Gumi AI Data Center (ex-Samsung Electronics Gumi Plant 1)
notes: Samsung SDS disclosed (board resolution, Jan 2 2026) investment of KRW 427.3bn (~USD 295m) for a 60MW-class AI/hyperscale data center in Gumi on the site of the former Samsung Electronics Gumi Plant 1 (244 1gongdan-ro), acquired Dec 2024 for KRW 21.5bn; MOU with Gyeongsangbuk-do province and Gumi City signed at CES 2026 (Jan 7-8); target operation March 2029, positioned as GPUaaS outpost; DART equipment-budget filing in mid-2026 reported groundbreaking as imminent; Baxtel still lists site as land bank.

name: Quantilevera (Quantum XI) Gumi Advanced AI Data Center Cluster
developer: Quantilevera (Quantum XI) consortium with NH Investment & Securities, KB Securities, Rohode Partners; Gyeongsangbuk-do and Gumi City
notes: Business agreement (Dec 18 2025) between Gyeongsangbuk-do/Gumi City and Quantilevera consortium for a KRW 4.5 trillion, 1.3GW-class AI data center cluster in Gumi by 2029; Phase 1 is a 300MW AI data center inside Gumi High-Tech Valley 5 industrial complex targeted for completion by H1 2027, expanding Gumi Hi-Tech Energy's earlier 100MW AI data center plan to 300MW; cluster promoted as Asia's largest advanced AI data center cluster.
